:::{#exr-linear-map-lincom-practice}
#### Evaluating a linear map on a linear combination

A [linear map](#def-linear-map) is determined on a [linear combination](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-linear-combination) of vectors
by its values on those vectors alone.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be a linear map with

$$
f(\vecf{v}_1) = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
f(\vecf{v}_2) = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ -1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $f(3 \vecf{v}_1 - 2 \vecf{v}_2)$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Apply @thm-linear-map-lincom with $c_1 = 3$ and $c_2 = -2$.

:::

:::
